candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Guidance Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the custom photo upload screen into a two-column layout featuring an active upload quality checklist and ideal photo sample images.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 71.9%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear Photo of Your Pet
upload_photos.body: For best results, use well-lit photos with your pet facing forward.

components.label: Good lighting, sharp focus, single pet in frame

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Desktop Control Shortcuts Sandbox Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive sandbox screen at the end of onboarding where users test pet drag, click, and tray controls before completing setup.
candidates.why: 7 support emails asked how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after setup, contributing to a drop in finish completion (64.8%).

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Try moving and controlling your pet in the sandbox below before placing it on your desktop.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_controls_sandbox']

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostics Wait Screen
candidates.change: Rebuilds the waiting step into a system diagnostic verification status view that confirms screen overlay permissions and engine load.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to show on desktop, while waiting time averages a long 201s median / 2336s mean.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Overlay
waiting.body: Checking graphics renderer, desktop tray access, and asset files...

guard.reason: The waiting screen must show that the pet is being made; system diagnostics remove this core job.

candidates.title: Story Companion Intro Flow Shift
candidates.change: Reorders the opening experience so the story screen introduces pet types in a full-bleed split view before path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path step has high mean time (514s) and 20.9% drop-off, indicating users need context before choosing a path.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop World
story.body: Choose whether you want a pre-made pet companion or a custom creation from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigning layout and text while retaining story introduction and required flow is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 20.9% of users with long mean time; UI redesign requires a full release.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint
candidates.change: Displays a prominent sync hint explaining that logging into an existing account restores previous pets automatically without losing data.
candidates.why: 8 emails (the top support issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into an existing account safely recovers all previously adopted pets and inventory.

guard.reason: Adding account pet recovery hints on sign in is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses top support complaint (8 emails) at sign-in step via simple config/text update.

candidates.title: Background Engine Render Time Estimator
candidates.change: Adds an active countdown timer and generation progress estimator bar on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Median waiting time is 201 seconds with extreme tail mean times (2336s), causing uncertainty during asset generation.

waiting.hint: Generation takes 1 to 3 minutes depending on model complexity.

guard.reason: Progress bars and real wait time estimates during pet generation are permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step already has 91.9% conversion; adding interactive timer component requires new screens/code.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Visibility Quick Instructions
candidates.change: Updates home_intro text to explicitly guide users on using the system tray icon to show, hide, or recall their pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets complained about pets disappearing or missing from desktop after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: If your pet hides, click the tray icon in your taskbar or press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon it instantly.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro text with desktop pet control instructions is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest drop-off (35.2%) and 3 support tickets; fix is copy-only.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Layout
candidates.change: Swaps the adoption certificate screen layout to a card view with an animated mascot stamp and official badge.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 28.1% with median duration of 89s; visual celebratory feedback increases completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is officially registered and ready to move onto your desktop!

guard.reason: The certificate screen must include an official stamp; replacing it with a mascot asset loses this required element.

candidates.title: Companion Starter Perk Choice Cards
candidates.change: Adds visual choice cards on the choose_path screen showcasing bonus starter items unlocked with each path.
candidates.why: choose_path has 20.9% drop-off; highlighting starter perks drives quicker decision-making.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Each path includes exclusive starter accessories for your companion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention gifts, bonus items, or free extras like starter accessories.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Ready Tray Alert Prompt
candidates.change: Adds a desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes in the background.
candidates.why: Mean wait time on the waiting step reaches 2336 seconds, causing users to minimize the app and forget to return.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready to join your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding desktop notification prompts for generation completion on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) on home step, but target step already converts 91.9%.

picked: Desktop Engine Ready Tray Alert Prompt

decisions.title: Desktop Engine Ready Tray Alert Prompt
